title: Changelog
sections:
  - id: releases
    items:
      - title: "0.1.0"
        sections:
          - id: changes
            items:
              - title: added
                set:
                  notes: |
                    <<- All-or-nothing sample validation (`validateSample`): a candidate is admitted only as a fully well-formed `Sample`, and a rejection names the offending field (`series`, `value`, or `at`) rather than failing silently.
                    - An injectable clock (`SystemClock` for real time, `FixedClock` for tests) so every window boundary and retention sweep is deterministic to test.
                    - Environment-driven configuration (`ROLLUP_WINDOW_MS`, `ROLLUP_MAX_SAMPLES`, `ROLLUP_RETENTION_MS`) with built-in defaults; a present-but-unusable value throws rather than falling back silently.
                    - A bounded in-memory ingest queue (`IngestQueue`) with a wire-line parser accepting `<series> <value> [<at>]`; on overflow the queue drops the *oldest* buffered sample and keeps a running dropped count.>>
      - title: "0.2.0"
        sections:
          - id: changes
            items:
              - title: added
                set:
                  notes: |
                    <<- An in-memory, per-series sample store (`MemoryStore`) keeping each series' samples sorted by timestamp and capped at a configured depth per series.
                    - Fixed-width window rollups (`rollup`, `windowsFor`) and per-series summaries (`summarize`/`formatSummary`: count, mean, min, max) over a trailing time span.
                    - A transport-agnostic router (`Router`) exposing the service over `POST /samples`, `GET /series`, and `GET /summary/:series`, plus the `createService` wiring that assembles config, clock, queue, and store into one running service.>>
